# Toolsy

> Free browser-based online tools for AI, SEO, content creators, developers, PDF, and video workflows. All processing runs privately client-side in the user's browser, with optional, stateless AI features. No registration, no cookies, no signup.

## Core Information
- [Home Page](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/) - Primary search interface and tool catalog.
- [About Us](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/about-us) - Platform mission, technology stack (React, Vite, TailwindCSS, Client-Side WASM), and browser processing model.
- [Contact Us](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/contact-us) - Support email, business queries, and feedback channels.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/privacy-policy) - Privacy-first terms: client-side execution, stateless API integrations, zero data retention.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/terms-and-conditions) - Acceptable usage, code generation license, and limitation of liability.

## Tool Categories & Popular Utilities

### Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & AEO
- [GEO Content Optimizer](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/geo-content-optimizer) - Restructures text content for maximum citation rate, information density, and semantic matching in generative engines (ChatGPT Search, Gemini, Perplexity).
- [Answer Engine FAQ Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/aeo-answer-generator) - Generates highly direct Q&A blocks and ready-to-use FAQ schema.
- [Brand Mention Optimizer](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/brand-mention-optimizer) - Refines brand descriptions and bios to match entity recognition patterns of LLMs.
- [Search to Prompt Converter](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/llm-prompt-to-query) - Formulates advanced query operators (site:, filetype:, before:) to help AI search agents locate source citations.

### AI Writing & SEO Content
- [AI Meta Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/ai-meta-generator) - Generates optimized title tags and meta descriptions using target keywords.
- [AI Paragraph Rewriter](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/ai-paragraph-rewriter) - Refines paragraph flow, conciseness, and tone using model parameters.
- [AI Title Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/ai-title-generator) - Generates click-worthy, intent-aligned headline ideas for blogs and landing pages.
- [Keyword Clustering Tool](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/keyword-clustering-tool) - Groups raw keyword lists into semantic clusters for architectural mapping.
- [Schema Markup Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/schema-markup-generator) - Generates JSON-LD schema (SoftwareApplication, Article, Product, FAQPage) locally.
- [FAQ Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/faq-generator) - Generates traditional SEO frequently asked questions.

### Social Media & Video Creators
- [Video Clip Cutter](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/video-clipper) - Trims uploaded video files locally (MP4, MOV, WebM) without watermarks or server uploads.
- [Vertical Clip Safe Zone Helper](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/clip-safezone-visualizer) - Displays overlays for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts UI layouts.
- [Clip Duration Calculator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/clip-duration-calculator) - Translates word counts to expected pacing timings.
- [Clip Idea Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/clip-idea-generator) - Extracts short clips and talking points from transcripts.
- [Video Hook Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/video-hook-generator) - Generates opening hook ideas.
- [Shorts Script Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/shorts-script-generator) - Creates scripts with visual, audio, and pacing cues.
- [Content Calendar Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/content-calendar-generator) - Builds 30-day creator schedules.
- [Hashtag Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/hashtag-generator) - Generates hashtags categorized by reach.
- [Instagram Caption Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/instagram-caption-generator) - Formats social posts.
- [YouTube Description Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/youtube-description-generator) - Writes video descriptions with timestamps and links.

### PDF & Document Workflows
- [Merge PDF Free](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/pdf-merger) - Joins multiple PDF files.
- [PDF to Image](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/pdf-to-image) - Converts PDF pages to JPG, PNG, or WebP.
- [Image to PDF](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/image-to-pdf) - Bundles images into a PDF.
- [PDF Compressor](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/pdf-compressor) - Lowers PDF size.
- [PDF Splitter](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/pdf-splitter) - Extracts page ranges.
- [PDF Watermark](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/pdf-watermark) - Adds watermarks.
- [PDF Page Remover](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/pdf-page-remover) - Deletes selected pages from PDFs.
- [Word to PDF](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/word-to-pdf) - Converts DOCX/DOC.
- [Excel to PDF](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/excel-to-pdf) - Converts XLSX/XLS.
- [PPT to PDF](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/ppt-to-pdf) - Converts PowerPoint.
- [PDF to Word](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/pdf-to-word) - Converts PDFs to editable DOCX.

### Developer Utilities & Scripts
- [Commit Message Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/commit-message-generator) - Generates conventional git commits.
- [Regex Explainer](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/regex-explainer) - Breaks down regular expression syntax in plain English.
- [cURL Command Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/curl-command-generator) - Builds curl templates locally.
- [JSON Formatter](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/json-formatter) - Validates, minifies, and prints formatted JSON.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/base64-encoder) - Encodes and decodes base64 strings.
- [Hash Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/hash-generator) - Computes local MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 hashes.

### Images, Media & Archives
- [Image Resizer](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/image-resizer) - Resizes images locally.
- [Image Compressor](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/image-compressor) - Compresses images.
- [Image Converter](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/image-converter) - Formats converter.
- [Image Cropper](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/image-cropper) - Crops images.
- [Video to Audio](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/video-to-audio) - Extracts audio stream.
- [Thumbnail Maker](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/video-thumbnail-maker) - Extracts frames as video thumbnails.
- [Video to Frames](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/video-to-frames) - Exports frame ranges as ZIP.
- [Video Compressor](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/video-compressor) - Optimizes video files.
- [Direct MP4 Downloader](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/direct-mp4-downloader) - Saves direct public MP4 links.
- [ZIP Extractor](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/zip-extractor) - Extracts ZIP/RAR in-browser.
- [ZIP Creator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/zip-creator) - Compresses archives.

### Utility & Conversions
- [QR Code Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/qr-code-generator) - Creates custom QR codes.
- [Barcode Generator](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/barcode-generator) - Generates barcode formats.
- [Color Converter](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/color-converter) - HEX, RGB, HSL converter.
- [Unit Converter](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/unit-converter) - Metric-imperial conversion.
- [Text to Speech](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/text-to-speech) - Text reader.
- [Text Formatter](https://www.toolsylab.xyz/tool/text-formatter) - Case transformation and whitespace cleaner.
